Launch business-analyst with specification-writing skill for task {task_id}: "{title}". LOAD: specification-writing workflow refine-task-requirements.md. READ: (1) Task spec at {file_path}, (2) Parent feature PRD for feature-level intent, (3) Feature research report for codebase patterns and integration points, (4) Task notes (shark task get {task_id} --json) for blocker context, (5) Architecture docs for constraints. PRODUCE: Updated task spec with testable user stories, measurable acceptance criteria, business rules, edge cases. ALSO VERIFY: requirements align with feature PRD (no spec drift), codebase standards referenced (absorbs former task research), contracts consistent with architecture. EXIT GATE: AC unambiguous and measurable. No vague language. Traces to feature PRD. Blocker notes addressed. Advance: shark task next-status {task_id}.

Launch architect with architecture and specification-writing skills for task {task_id}: "{title}". LOAD: specification-writing workflow refine-task-requirements.md (architect path). READ: (1) Task spec at {file_path}, (2) BA-refined requirements, (3) Feature architecture docs (02-08 series), (4) Feature research report for patterns and integration points, (5) Blocker notes if returning from dev/review. PRODUCE: Updated task spec or PRP with API contracts, data models, architecture decisions with rationale, security/performance considerations. Verify contracts consistent with feature architecture. Reference codebase patterns from feature research. EXIT GATE: Contracts defined. Models specified. Decisions documented. No TBDs. Consistent with feature architecture. Task implementable without ambiguity. Advance: shark task next-status {task_id}.

Launch developer with test-driven-development skill for task {task_id}: "{title}". LOAD: test-driven-development + implementation skills. READ: (1) Task spec at {file_path}, (2) Feature test plan (09-test-plan.md) for test cases, acceptance criteria tests, and API contract tests relevant to this task, (3) Feature architecture docs for contracts and patterns, (4) Feature research report for codebase conventions. TDD PROCESS: Read the feature test plan first -- find the test cases that map to this task's acceptance criteria. Write those tests first (they should fail). Then implement to make tests pass following the task spec and architecture docs. Tests are written with USER GOALS in mind -- they validate persona needs and user journey steps, not just technical correctness. EXIT GATE: All mapped test cases from feature test plan pass. Implementation matches task spec. Code follows codebase conventions from research. Advance: shark task next-status {task_id}.

Launch tech-lead with quality skill to review task {task_id}: "{title}". LOAD: quality skill. READ: (1) Task spec at {file_path}, (2) Feature test plan (09-test-plan.md) for expected test coverage and acceptance criteria, (3) Feature PRD for feature-level intent, (4) Implementation code changes. REVIEW: Check code quality, security, and adherence to codebase standards. Compare implementation behavior against the task spec, the feature test plan, and the parent feature PRD. Verify acceptance criteria are met as specified in the feature requirements, not just as implemented. Verify TDD compliance -- tests from feature test plan are implemented and passing. Flag any deviation between feature intent, spec, and actual behavior. EXIT GATE: Code quality passes. Tests from feature plan implemented and passing. No spec drift from feature PRD. Advance: shark task next-status {task_id}.

Launch qa agent with quality skill to test task {task_id}: "{title}". LOAD: quality skill. READ: (1) Task spec at {file_path}, (2) Feature test plan (09-test-plan.md) for the acceptance test cases mapped to this task, (3) Feature PRD for feature-level intent, (4) Implementation code and test results. VALIDATE: Run test cases from feature test plan that map to this task. Verify acceptance criteria are met per the feature test plan, not just the task spec. Check edge cases identified in the test plan. Validate integration points behave correctly. EXIT GATE: All mapped test cases pass. Acceptance criteria validated against feature intent. No regressions in sibling task functionality. Advance: shark task next-status {task_id}.

Research epic {id}: "{title}". STRATEGIC RESEARCH -- assess system-wide impact and feasibility. LOAD: discovery skill (market-research, feasibility-analysis) + research skill (analyze-codebase, find-patterns). READ: Epic document at {file_path}. Read all sibling epic docs under docs/plan/ to identify overlap and interactions. Check existing system capabilities in codebase. PRODUCE: Research report containing: (1) Market/competitive landscape, (2) Feasibility assessment, (3) System-wide impact -- how this epic interacts with other epics, (4) Existing capability overlap, (5) Risk assessment with mitigations, (6) Recommendations. EXIT GATE: All 6 sections complete. No unresolved feasibility blockers. Overlap explicitly addressed. Advance: shark epic next-status {id}.

ready_for_refinement.description: Research complete, ready for BA to write epic PRD

orchestrator_action.instruction_template: Write epic PRD for {id}: "{title}". LOAD: specification-writing workflow write-epic.md -- follow multi-file architecture. READ: (1) Research report from epic research phase, (2) Epic document at {file_path}, (3) Other epic PRDs under docs/plan/ for consistency. PRODUCE: 6 PRD files per write-epic.md (epic.md, personas.md, user-journeys.md, requirements.md, success-metrics.md, scope.md). Requirements must trace to research findings. Success metrics must be measurable. Scope boundaries must reference research overlap analysis. EXIT GATE: All 6 files created and cross-referenced. Write-epic.md checklist passes. No vague language or TBDs. Advance: shark epic next-status {id}.

ready_for_test_planning.description: Epic PRD complete, ready for UAT acceptance plan

orchestrator_action.instruction_template: Create UAT acceptance plan for epic {id}: "{title}". STRATEGIC TEST PLANNING -- define how we know this epic delivers what it promises. READ: (1) Epic PRD at {file_path} -- all 6 files (epic.md, personas.md, user-journeys.md, requirements.md, success-metrics.md, scope.md), (2) Research report for feasibility constraints and risk areas, (3) Other epic UAT plans under docs/plan/ for cross-epic test coverage. PRODUCE: Epic UAT plan containing: (1) Acceptance scenarios derived from each user journey, (2) Success metrics validation plan, (3) Cross-epic integration test scenarios, (4) Risk-based test priorities, (5) Persona-based acceptance matrix. EXIT GATE: Every user journey has at least one acceptance scenario. Every success metric has a validation method. Risk areas have targeted scenarios. Plan is actionable for feature-level decomposition into test strategies. Advance: shark epic next-status {id}.

in_test_planning.description: QA creating epic UAT acceptance plan

ready_for_decomposition.description: Epic PRD and UAT plan complete, ready to decompose into features

orchestrator_action.instruction_template: Decompose epic {id}: "{title}" into features. LOAD: specification-writing workflow decompose-epic.md. READ: (1) Full epic PRD at {file_path} (all 6 files), (2) Research report for feasibility constraints and system interactions, (3) Success metrics to ensure features trace to outcomes, (4) Existing features (shark feature list --epic={id}). PRODUCE: For each feature: create in shark (shark feature create --epic={id} --title="Name"), write scope description, define execution order and dependencies, map to epic requirements. Output decomposition summary with feature tree and dependency graph. EXIT GATE: Every epic requirement traces to a feature. No scope overlap. Acyclic dependencies. Each feature sized for 1-3 sprints. Reviewed with user. Advance: shark epic next-status {id}.

ready_for_research.description: Ready for tactical codebase and integration research

orchestrator_action.instruction_template: Research feature {id}: "{title}". TACTICAL RESEARCH -- analyze codebase and integration points informed by parent epic research. LOAD: research skill (analyze-codebase, trace-dependencies, find-patterns, understand-feature). READ: (1) Parent epic research report and PRD for strategic context, (2) Feature description at {file_path}, (3) Sibling features (shark feature list) for inter-feature interactions, (4) Codebase: CLAUDE.md, architecture docs for conventions. PRODUCE: Feature research report: (1) Codebase patterns relevant to this feature, (2) Existing implementations with file paths, (3) Integration points (services, APIs, tables), (4) Extension vs new code analysis, (5) Inter-feature technical dependency map, (6) Implementation approach recommendations. EXIT GATE: All sections populated with codebase evidence. File paths cited. Integration points identified. Actionable for BA and architect. Advance: shark feature next-status {id}.

ready_for_refinement_ba.description: Ready for business analysis and requirements specification

orchestrator_action.instruction_template: Write feature PRD for {id}: "{title}". LOAD: specification-writing workflow write-feature-prd.md. READ: (1) Feature research report for codebase patterns and integration points, (2) Parent epic PRD for scope boundaries and requirements traceability, (3) Feature description at {file_path}, (4) Other feature PRDs in this epic for consistency. PRODUCE: Comprehensive prd.md: Goal, User Personas, User Stories (MoSCoW), Functional/Non-Functional Requirements, Acceptance Criteria, Out of Scope. Must reference research findings for feasibility. Requirements must trace to epic requirements. EXIT GATE: All sections complete per write-feature-prd.md checklist. Acceptance criteria testable. Research findings integrated. Open questions resolved with user. Advance: shark feature next-status {id}.

ready_for_refinement_tech.description: Requirements complete, ready for technical architecture

orchestrator_action.instruction_template: Design technical architecture for feature {id}: "{title}". LOAD: architecture skill workflows (design-system, design-backend, design-frontend, design-database, design-security) as applicable. READ: (1) Feature PRD at {file_path}/prd.md, (2) Feature research report for codebase patterns and existing implementations, (3) Parent epic architecture docs for system constraints, (4) Other feature architectures in this epic for cross-feature consistency. PRODUCE: Architecture docs in feature directory: 02-architecture.md, 03-data-design.md, 04-backend-design.md, 05-frontend-design.md (if applicable), 06-security-design.md, 07-performance-design.md, 08-implementation-phases.md. Follow patterns from research. EXIT GATE: All applicable docs created. API contracts with request/response schemas. Data models complete. No conflicts with sibling features. Cross-feature integration points documented. Advance: shark feature next-status {id}.

ready_for_test_planning.description: Architecture complete, ready for feature test strategy

orchestrator_action.instruction_template: Create feature test plan for {id}: "{title}". TACTICAL TEST PLANNING -- break down epic UAT scenarios into feature-specific, locally testable strategies. API contracts have positive and negative test cases. Advance: shark feature next-status {id}.
